accent.comment: Brand color. A placeholder blue until the project sets it.

strong.comment: Edge of a control, such as a field. At least 3:1 on the page surface, which WCAG 1.4.11 asks of a control's boundary.

s.comment: Corner radius of a part inside a component, and of inline code. A component's own radius is `ui.border.radius`.

width.comment: Focus ring width. One ring on every focusable element.

offset.comment: Gap between an element and its focus ring. An element the ring would clip draws it inset, at the negative of this.

hover.comment: Share of the text color mixed into the background while the pointer is over a control.

press.comment: Share of the text color mixed into the background while a control is pressed, and of the accent on a selected or current item.

duration.comment: Length of a state change, such as a hover layer.

height.comment: Height of a button, field, or tab. A component raises it to 2.75rem for a coarse pointer.

s.comment: Icon size beside text. It follows the font size.

m.comment: Icon size beside a heading or a title.

shadow.comment: Elevation shadow. For things that float, such as search results.

base.comment: Page surface. Light and dark values.

accent.value: light-dark(oklch(from color-mix(in oklch, var(--norn-ui-accent, {ui.accent}) 82%, black) min(l, 0.5) c h), oklch(from color-mix(in oklch, var(--norn-ui-accent, {ui.accent}) 55%, white) max(l, 0.72) c h))
accent.comment: The accent for text and links: darkened in light mode, lightened in dark mode. The lightness caps keep any accent at 4.5:1 or better.

on-accent.value: color(from var(--norn-ui-accent, {ui.accent}) xyz-d65 calc(0.95047 * clamp(0, calc((0.1791 - y) * 1000000), 1)) clamp(0, calc((0.1791 - y) * 1000000), 1) calc(1.08883 * clamp(0, calc((0.1791 - y) * 1000000), 1)))
on-accent.comment: Black or white text for an accent background, whichever contrasts more: at least 4.58:1. Switches at relative luminance 0.1791.

heading.comment: Heading face. Follows the body face until the project sets one.

s.comment: Small text: captions, code, navigation, and notes.

l.comment: Lede, card title, and third-level heading.

xl.comment: Second-level heading. Larger titles use a clamp.

info.comment: Information. The color of a note or an information notice.

success.comment: Success. The color of a tip, a success notice, and a copied mark.

danger.comment: Danger. The color of a caution and an error.
